scope: Twenty-seven exact base-text tedy/teda sites whose clause role is equivalence, restatement, or explication.
choice: Replace only the selected token ordinals with branch-neutral to jest; preserve adjacent same-line consequence markers.
motivation: German and clause syntax show 'that is/in other words', not time or inference. Ordinal binding prevents corruption on lines mixing explication and consequence.
alternatives_rejected: zato would turn restatements into conclusions.
imenno is narrower than several equivalence/restatement sites.

evidence.context_review: All 27 exact occurrences were classified against German also/appositive or definitional syntax; eight adjacent consequence ordinals were explicitly guarded.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: frozen hashes reproduced before atomic apply
